Free to use. Works offline.Online sharing links require an internet connection.

BEFORE YOU
GET STARTED.

How do I install it?

Download the APK on your Android phone and open it from Downloads. If Android asks, allow your browser to install this app, then tap Install. You can turn that permission off afterward.

How do I add the widget?

Add your classes in Schediel, then touch and hold an empty space on your home screen. Choose Widgets, find Schediel, and drag the schedule widget onto your wallpaper. Change its appearance in the app’s widget settings.

Does sharing work offline?

Schedule files can be shared offline. Creating or opening online sharing links needs an internet connection.

Which phones can use this APK?

This download is for ARM64 Android phones running Android 8.0 or newer. It cannot be installed on an iPhone.
